newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Orbital gets A$14.5 mln for research.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Orbital gets A$14.5 mln for research.

text.p: Orbital Engine Corporation Ltd said on Wednesday it had secured funding for a A$14.5 million programme to develop the next generation direct fuel injection, combustion and and engine control technologies for automotive engine applications.

Orbital chief executive Kim Schlunke said in a statement the direct injection of fuel into the combustion chamber of four-stroke gasoline engines had emerged as the next major evolutionary step for current generation automotive engines.
Direct injection could improve fuel consumption by 10 to 30 percent while achieving reduced exhaust emissions and increased power output, he said.
Schlunke said the funding would come through the Australian government-backed R&D Syndication, and did not involve Orbital taking a loan or issuing equity.
Siemens Automotive and Orbital announced last week they would establish a joint venture to develop and sell fuel rail assemblies incorporating Orbital's direct fuel injection technology.
